data.name: Huraira
data.gender_notes: Huraira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A small, playful, and cute kitten. The name Huraira carries the meaning “Kitten” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Huraira usually hope their child will grow to embody kitten and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Huraira was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) known for his excellent memory and narration of Hadith.
data.etymology: Huraira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Kitten.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Huraira total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: حُريه
in_arabic.long_meaning: حُريه، اسمٌ علم، مشتقٌ من الحُرُّ، المُحرَّر، الإِحسان، التَّحرير، الإِنسان. ويُعتبر من أسماء الأقدار. وفي حديث النبي صلّى اللَهُ عليه وَسلم: «الناسُ أُمَّةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ إِلَيهِ رِجالٌ حُرُّونَ وَإِنامٌ حُرُّونَ، وَيُدعى إِلَيهِمُ عَلى لِسانِ الَّذي يَرى بِهِ الَّذي يَكادُ يَطغى عَلَيهِ، وَإِنَّما هَؤُلاءِ مُحَرَّرُونَ، وَالناسُ أُمَّةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ، إِنَّما يَرى بِهِمُ لِسانُ الَّذي يَرى بِهِ». وفي حديث الآخرة: «حُريهُ أَسماءٌ لِلَّهِ أَعزَمُ مَعنيً مِنَ الدُنيا»

in_urdu.name: حُریہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: حُریہ، ایک علمي نام ہے جو حُرُّ، مُحرَّر، احسان، تحرير سے مشتق ہے۔ یہ نام اقدار کے ناموں میں سے ہے۔ نبی اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہ وسلم کا حديث ہے: «الناسُ أُمَّةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ إِلَيهِ رِجالٌ حُرُّونَ وَإِنامٌ حُرُّونَ، وَيُدعى إِلَيهِمُ عَلى لِسانِ الَّذي يَرى بِهِ الَّذي يَكادُ يَطغى عَلَيهِ، وَإِنَّما هَؤُلاءِ مُحَرَّرُونَ، وَالناسُ أُمَّةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ، إِنَّما يَرى بِهِمُ لِسانُ الَّذي يَرى بِهِ»۔ نبی اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہ وسلم کا دوسرا حديث ہے: «حُریہُ أَسماءٌ لِلَّهِ أَعزَمُ مَعنيً مِنَ الدُنيا»

in_hindi.name: हरीरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: हरीरा एक पवित्र नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है मुक्ति, मुक्ति, अह्सान, और तहरीर। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत पवित्र है। नबी का नाम हरीरा एक पवित्र नाम है जो इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत पवित्र है।

in_pashto.name: هریه
in_pashto.long_meaning: هریه یوځای نوم دی چې له عربي څخه رامینځته شوې، حر، آزاد، احسان، تحریر یوځای موندل شوی دی. دا نوم اسلامي پوهنه کې د اقدارو نومونو په کچه څخه دی. دا نوم د الله (ج) په نومونو کې شامل دی چې د دنیا څخه د ډیر معنی په اساس دی.

in_english.name: Huraira
in_english.long_meaning: Huraira, a name of Islamic significance, derived from Arabic roots, conveying the meanings of freedom, liberation, benevolence, and deliverance. It is considered a name of destiny in Islamic tradition. In a Hadith, the Prophet Muhammad said: "The people are one nation, with men who are free and men who are slaves, and they are called to account on the Day of Judgment." Huraira is also mentioned in a Hadith as one of Allah's names, greater in meaning than the world.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic history, Anas ibn Malik, a companion of Prophet Muhammad, was commonly referred to as Abu Huraira (Father of the Kitten) due to his compassionate care for a small kitten he found abandoned in the Prophet's mosque. The name Huaira became synonymous with kindness, gentleness, and protection towards animals, reflecting the Islamic principle of treating every living being with respect and compassion.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Huraira holds deeper spiritual significance as it relates to the virtue of compassion and tenderness towards all creation. The Prophet's companion, Abu Huraira, served as an embodiment of God's instruction in the Quran to treat animals with kindness (Al-Baqarah: 68). The spiritual meaning behind this name encourages us to appreciate the little things in life and to engage in acts of kindness towards all beings as a form of worship and closeness to Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Kitten" symbolizes A small, playful, and cute kitten.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Huraira serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of kitten.
